name: Elantas Beck India Ltd
about: ELANTAS Beck India Limited is engaged in manufacturing a wide range of specialty chemicals in the electrical insulation and construction industries. It is a part of ALTANA, an international specialty chemicals group. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Segments
**Electrical Insulation Business **
It caters to Magnet Wire manufacturers, whose end customer base spans the Home Appliances, Transformers, automotive, and Industrial Segments. Secondary Insulation products like Varnishes find application in Rotating Machines used in Home Appliances, Automotive Components, Industrial Motors, etc. [1]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 23.0% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 7.90 times its book value
